metadata.title: software-android-design - Primary Sources
metadata.description: Material Design and Android developer references for native Android design guidance
metadata.note: Look up Android release status, Play target-API policy, Compose BOM mapping, and per-component release-channel/opt-in status at the owning official pages. No release or policy snapshot is maintained here.

official_google.name: Material Design 3
official_google.description: Primary design reference for Material Design 3 components, styles, and foundations

official_google.name: Material Design 3 Expressive
official_google.description: Material 3 Expressive update with enhanced motion, shape, color, and component expressiveness

official_google.name: Compose Material 3 API Reference
official_google.description: Kotlin reference for installed Compose Material 3 component APIs; check availability and opt-in annotations against the installed artifact and release notes.

official_google.description: Android design hub for UI guidelines, adaptive layouts, and Material integration

official_google.name: Material Symbols and Icons
official_google.description: Official Material icon library for Android

official_google.name: Material 3
official_google.description: Canonical Material 3 (incl. Expressive) design guidance. Verify alpha/stable API surface (MotionScheme, shape morphing) at use-time.

official_google.name: Android 16 Platform
official_google.description: Behavior changes for apps targeting Android 16, including resizability, edge-to-edge, and predictive back. This is a behavior boundary, not a current-release claim.

official_google.name: Android 17 Release Notes
official_google.description: Android 17 platform and behavior changes; verify release status at the versions hub before calling it current.

official_google.name: Google Play Target API Requirements
official_google.description: Look up the applicable app category, target API, deadline, and extension conditions before planning a release.

official_google.name: Predictive Back Gesture Guide
official_google.description: Supported back-navigation APIs and platform behavior; prefer built-in navigation/component handling and inspect custom interception.

official_google.name: Window Size Classes

official_google.name: WindowSizeClass API
official_google.description: Breakpoint constants, ordered matching, and deprecated width/height accessors.

official_google.name: Navigation 3 Scenes

official_google.description: Forward, pop, and predictive-pop transition specifications.

official_google.name: Compose Predictive Back
official_google.description: Default navigation/system animations and Material sheet/search behavior.

official_google.name: Lazy List Nesting
official_google.description: Unbounded same-axis nesting fails; bounded or different-axis nesting is valid.

official_google.name: Material 3 Release Notes
official_google.description: Check the release channel and API opt-in annotations separately.
